verdict.rationale: Ghostty has automation surfaces, so the scheduling axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows a recurring-job or scheduled-workflow capability. AppleScript and Apple Shortcuts support (ghostty-docs-9, ghostty-gh-6) only enables scripting that the host OS would have to trigger on a schedule, which is a host-platform workaround. The runtime probe also found no remote-control or IPC interface for external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
